methodology.verified: Price read from a page actually loaded in a real browser session (BigBasket defaulted to Bangalore/bbnow 10-min zone; Licious Bangalore). source_url is the page fetched.
methodology.reported: Price seen in a search-engine snippet of a platform page that blocks direct fetches (Blinkit/Zepto). Location-dependent; treat as indicative.
methodology.derived: Quick-commerce price computed as BigBasket verified price +10% (stated markup), because Blinkit/Zepto/Instamart do not render prices without a pincode session.
methodology.estimated: No page fetched; number is a reasonable Bangalore market assumption.
methodology.qty_disclaimer: ALL per-serving and weekly quantities are assumptions for one ~3,000 kcal/day adult male; every item carries estimated: true for quantities even when the price is verified.

tier_definitions.lean: BigBasket big-pack staples + kirana/mandi for vegetables, fruit, milk (Nandini booth pouches), loose eggs; value brands (bb Popular/SUPER SAVER, Venkys frozen chicken); no memberships needed (1 big slotted order/week, often free delivery above cart threshold).
tier_definitions.normal: Everything on a single quick-commerce platform (Blinkit/Zepto/Instamart) at BigBasket-verified prices +10% derived markup, with a membership (Swiggy One / Zepto Club) killing most delivery fees at ~3 orders/week.
tier_definitions.convenience: Premium picks: Licious chicken (356/450g) & Prasuma sausages, Akshayakalpa organic milk, organic paneer/veg, Happilo nuts, imported avocado, quick-commerce without membership incl. surge/handling/small-cart fees.

totals.base_reference: Raw BigBasket-verified basket (before tier adjustments) computes to ~Rs 2,583/week ~= Rs 11,180/month for one person at 3,000 kcal/day.

delivery_reality.note: Blinkit: delivery ~Rs 16-30 + handling ~Rs 5-15 below free-delivery carts (thresholds are hyperlocal, commonly Rs 199-499; reports of Rs 16 fee even above Rs 199 in Bangalore micro-markets, Jan 2026). Zepto: similar fees; Zepto Club at Rs 99/month (invite-based intro) gives free delivery over Rs 99 carts + 5% Z-Coins. Swiggy Instamart: free delivery over Rs 99 with Swiggy One (~Rs 83-116/month effective; One Lite Rs 99/3 months = 10 free deliveries over Rs 199). BigBasket slotted delivery is free above modest cart values and bbnow mirrors quick-commerce fees.
delivery_reality.membership_math: At ~3 quick-commerce orders/week (13/month), unmembered fees run Rs 30-45/order = Rs 390-585/month. Swiggy One (~Rs 100/month) or Zepto Club (Rs 99/month) claws back ~Rs 300-480/month net - pays for itself 3-5x. On the lean tier (1 weekly BigBasket slot order) memberships add nothing.

cost_drivers.substitute: Licious curry cut small 500 g at 196 or Venkys frozen breast 430 g at 175 vs Delfrez 239/Licious breast 356 - same protein, saves Rs 250-690/month
Nandini booth/kirana pouches (Rs 24/500ml) instead of app UHT tetra (Rs 64+/L) - saves Rs 60-180/month
Stick to papaya/guava/watermelon/banana; skip pomegranate and imported fruit - nutrition equal or better fibre/vit-C per rupee
Use banana or pineapple in raita, keep 1 apple/week - saves ~Rs 400/month
Milky Mist 200 g at 70 (discounted) over Nandini 96; swap one paneer meal for tofu (69-75/200 g) - protein preserved
Always buy the 30-tray (249) not 6/12-packs; kirana loose ~Rs 7/egg = Rs 420/month
Set curd at home from the same milk (~40% cheaper) or Amul Masti 1 kg pouch at 77 over cups
Buy 500 g value packs (bb Popular 500); kirana loose California ~Rs 850-900/kg is slightly cheaper - do not cut, best calorie quality in the plan
Costliest nut per gram (Rs 2000+/kg kernels); alternate pista days with roasted chana/peanuts at ~1/10th the cost, protein similar
Nandini 1 L pouch (656) beats 500 ml jars per ml; Milky Mist 500 ml at 296 on discount

kirana_better: All vegetables (local mandi/HOPCOMS ~20-30% below app prices, esp. palak, bhindi, tomato)
Nandini milk and curd at booth MRP (apps charge premium or push UHT)
Loose eggs (~Rs 7/pc vs Rs 8.3/pc on apps)
Loose dals, poha, sattu, besan (flour-mill/kirana loose ~10-20% cheaper than branded)
Fresh atta from local chakki (often cheaper + fresher than 5 kg branded bags)
Ginger, lemon, green chilli, coriander (mandi bunches, near-zero cost)
Whole spices from kirana loose counters
